statement: The owner reviewed the final numbers, including three targeted prefill re-runs, judged the prefill results acceptable and decided to keep E29 as the new baseline.
accepted_trade_off: Against E28b: C1/C2/C4 per-stream TTFT -13.2%/-14.7%/-9.8%, code decode +3.2%, no metric worse beyond noise. Against E27c cached replay remains 56-82 ms slower at 8K/32K because an immediate replay waits for the cache connector to publish the preceding request.
